:::{#def-trace}

#### Trace

The **trace** of a $p \times p$ matrix $\matr{M}$
is the sum of its diagonal entries:

$$\operatorname{tr}(\matr{M}) \eqdef \sum_{i=1}^p M_{ii}$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-trace}

#### The trace of a $2 \times 2$ matrix

$$
\operatorname{tr}\paren{\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}} = 1 + 4 = 5
$$

:::
